_status: OWNER-APPROVAL CONCEPT. Not the official website. Facts below come from the business's own published pages (official homepage, FAQ, 2026 menu Revision 26.03) and named press, as researched 7 Nov 2026. Nothing here is owner-confirmed yet.
name: Rick's Cafe
subtype: cliffside bar and restaurant (not a hotel, not on Seven Mile Beach, no overnight rooms)
one_liner: Food, drinks, music and the famous West End cliffs of Negril. No cover charge.
about: Richard "Rick" Hershman opened Rick's Cafe on Negril's West End cliffs in April 1974. Destroyed by Hurricane Gilbert (1988) and Hurricane Ivan (2004), it was rebuilt both times.
president: Tom Martin (named as President on the official 2026 menu)

founder_quote.text: Your body has finally arrived where your mind has always been.

timezone_note: Jamaica time, UTC-5 all year (no daylight saving). Do not label as U.S. Eastern Daylight Time.
address_source: Printed on the official 2026 menu. Westmoreland parish per Jamaica Observer (20 May 2015). No street number or postcode verified.
map_embed_source: Reused exactly from the official homepage. Its centre is a viewport, not a surveyed pin; directory coordinates conflict, so no geo coordinates are published.

phones.label: Reservations & cabanas
phones.source: Official FAQ; printed on the 2026 menu as 876.957.o38o

phone_note: Official publications list two different numbers. Neither is chosen as primary and neither goes into structured data until the owner confirms. Never use +1 516-737-8269 (a tour operator).
email_source: Official homepage and FAQ (general and group inquiries)
hours_source: Official homepage: "Open to the public: Noon to 10pm Daily No Cover Charge". Official FAQ: "Open every day/365 days a year from Noon to 10PM".
hours_conflict: ArrivalGuides (third party) lists daily 12-9:30 p.m. Holiday exceptions and kitchen closing time were not published.

actions.notes: No online ordering, table booking, tickets, tours, delivery, hotel rooms, ecommerce, donations or payments. Group / cabana inquiries go to info@rickscafejamaica.com or by phone. The group inquiry form is a non-sending draft.

official_film.title: Rick's Cafe turns 47!
official_film.note: Historical anniversary film (c. 2021) from the official channel.

menu.terms: All prices are in U.S. dollars, are subject to change & do not include GCT or 10% service charge.

cabanas.source: Official FAQ (undated). Owner to confirm before these are treated as live prices.

colors_note: Sampled from the official logo (gold, green, wood brown). No official brand guide was found, so these are not official brand colours. The site palette (sea blues, sunset gold/ember/pink, thatch) is a concept choice.
